caption: The drawing depicts a single metal oil can with a conical body and a long, narrow spout. The oil can is colored in shades of brown and rust, with subtle variations to indicate metallic texture and wear. The spout extends from the front at a slight upward angle, with a bristled, dark green or brown cleaning brush inserted at the tip. The top of the can has a round cap and a simple looped handle attached to it. On the right side, a large, curved handle extends from the upper part of the body to the lower edge. The oil can is centered against a plain, light beige background, and below it, the name "ALEXANDER ANDERSON – 1939 –" is written in thin, grayish letters. No other objects or details are present in the composition.
